SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
I hope this email finds you well.
Regarding the issue of HMI black screen problem, Please check the following below:
Check for any loose connections to the screen and board.
Update the Dlogic firmware, if its not done in past.
Check for the 24VDC supply to the Dlogic board(PH2).
Verify if the DP cables have been changed in the past with this charger. If not, we suggest replacing them with new DP cables.
If the still persists after all the verification we suggest you in replacing the control panel with generation2. Please find the below MLFB number for the same.
MLFB for ordering spare part:
8EM5903-0AA03-8AA7 ---> Control panel
